method: Re-read each cited capture in kb/sources/glengoyne/ and re-ran targeted WebSearch (allowed_domains on cited source where possible) to reproduce each datapoint. WebFetch blocked (403); reproduction-by-search is the standard per whisky-verify SKILL.

fields.evidence_quote: "The 24 Year Old is matured in American First Fill Bourbon and Virgin Oak casks at 47.8% ABV" (robbreport capture; reproduced via WebSearch: '47.8% ABV ... American First Fill Bourbon and Virgin Oak casks')
"matured in American First Fill Bourbon and Virgin Oak casks" — confirmed sherry-distinct; official page titled 'White Oak'. Reproduced via WebSearch and TWE/glengoyne.com listings.

fields.claimed: Limited release; UK launch 10 Jul 2024 (RRP £430); US debut Mar 2025 ($400)
fields.evidence_quote: "This is a limited release that will not return once sold out"; "on sale now for a RRP £430"; "available ... on 10th July" (2024); US debut Mar 2025. Reproduced via WebSearch (glengoyne.com news, Spirits Business).
"The Glengoyne White Oak 24 Years Old received an A- rating from Drinkhacker"; reproduced via WebSearch. A- -> ~90 is a standard letter-grade normalization (defensible, not exact).

fields.field: scores[1] Robb Report '#2 whisky 2025 (Best of the Best 2025)'
fields.evidence_quote: "included in Robb Report's 'Best of The Best 2025' ... ranked as the 2nd best whisky released in 2025" — reproduces in WebSearch (TWE retailer snippet). CAVEAT: Robb Report's own site exposes only inclusion in 'The 10 Best Whiskeys of 2025 So Far'; the specific '#2 / Best of the Best 2025' phrasing traces to retailer marketing copy, not a Robb Report numbered list confirmed in-page. Non-core, awards-only (no 100-pt). Reproduces, so verified; provenance flagged.
"The Whisky Exchange is offering the Glengoyne White Oak 24 Year Old at £415.00" — reproduced via WebSearch (TWE p/81117).
"Hard to find Whisky ... listing it at £408.95" — in capture; consistent with reproduced UK listings.
"The Whisky Shop lists it at £453.00" — in capture.
"available at Total Wine & More for $399.98 ... 700ml" — reproduced verbatim via WebSearch (totalwine p/2126245842).
"reviewed in Whisky Advocate's Summer 2025 issue by Julia Higgins with a price of $400" — in capture; corroborated by Total Wine MSRP $400.

"The whisky value for Glengoyne 24-year-old White Oak Limited Release is €294, according to Whiskystats" — reproduced via WebSearch on whiskystats.com (whisky/253591). Currency EUR correctly labeled; value is BELOW retail (no secondary premium). No £/$ mislabel.

fields.claimed: vanilla, lemon curd, key-lime, chocolate; bourbon/virgin-oak profile
fields.evidence_quote: Robb Report nose 'vanilla and toasted oak, lemon curd, honey...'; Whisky Advocate 'chocolate ganache, cocoa powder'; Drinkhacker 'white chocolate ... grapefruit pith ... toasty charred oak' — all reproduce. No 24-vs-25 conflation; profile is bourbon/virgin-oak, sherry-distinct.

notes: All PRESENT core fields verify with no mismatch/unsupported. No 24-vs-25 conflation: the 24 is unambiguously White Oak (bourbon/virgin oak, 47.8%), corroborated by the official page title 'White Oak'. Currencies correct: Whiskystats value is EUR (€294) and is correctly labeled EUR (not mislabeled as £/$). Only caveat: the Robb Report '#2 / Best of the Best 2025' rank reproduces from retailer copy but is not confirmed as a numbered Robb Report list in-page; it is non-core (normalized_100=null) and does not gate pass.
